content:
Overview

Šilutė is a city in Šilutė District with a population of 17,000. A town in the Klaipėda region, known for its German-influenced architecture, the Šilutė Museum, and proximity to the Nemunas Delta and Curonian Spit. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
